REMINDER

  TO: CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMITTEE MEMBERS

 THERE WILL BE A CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMITTEE
  MEETING ON:

  WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 20, 2021 AT 7:00 P.M.
  ALHAMBRA CITY HALL
  111 SOUTH FIRST STREET, ALHAMBRA, CA 91801
  Via Video Conference

  IMPORTANT
Please call or e-mail by Tuesday whether or not you will be attending the
meeting so we know if there will be a quorum or not before the meeting.

  Kelsey Rivadeneyra, Clerical Assistant II
  (626) 570-5044 Direct: (626) 570-5046
  kelsey@cityofalhambra.org
   CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING OF THE
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMITTEE
  CORONAVRIUS (COVID-19) ADVISORY NOTICE
Consistent with Executive Orders No. N-29-20 and No. N-35-20 from the Executive Department of the
State of California and the County of Los Angeles Department of Public Health Safer at Home Order,
the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee will not be physically open to the public and
will take place via video conference.
To watch and listen to the meeting: To maximize public safety while still maintaining transparency
and public access, members of the public can participate by using Zoom Meeting as follows
https://us06web.zoom.us/j/83039432628?pwd=TjdjLzVvNTY1K2tqQzRDdDRUd2M5QT09 with
Meeting ID: 830 3943 2628 and Passcode: 824270.

Zoom Meeting direct link:
https://us06web.zoom.us/j/83039432628?pwd=TjdjLzVvNTY1K2tqQzRDdDRUd2M5QT09
For those wishing to speak on an agenda item, please e-mail Kelsey Rivadeneyra at
kelsey@cityofalhambra.org prior to the meeting with the item number you wish to speak on and your
name. You should then join into the meeting using Meeting ID: 830 3943 2628, and Passcode:
824270, or US Toll-free, 833 548 0282 US Toll-free, 877 853 5257 US Toll-free, 888 475 4499 US
Toll-free 10 minutes prior to its start time. Ms. Rivadeneyra will announce to you when it is your time
to speak. You will have five minutes to speak, unless that time is adjusted by the President.
As an alternative you can e-mail your comments by sending them to kelsey@cityofalhambra.org no
later than 5:00 P.M. on October 20, 2021 to ensure that it will be printed prior to the beginning of the
meeting. Comments will then be read into the record, with a maximum allowance of 5 minutes per
individual comment, subject to the President’s discretion. If a comment is received after 5:00 P.M. but
before the conclusion of the meeting based on its time stamp, the comment will still be included as a
part of the record of the meeting but will not be read into the record.
Any member of the public who needs accommodations or who needs their comments translated should
e-mail or call Kelsey Rivadeneyra at kelsey@cityofalhambra.org or (626) 570-5044 who will use their
best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations to provide as much accessibility as possible while
also maintaining public safety. Given the challenges of video conference meetings, all participants are
encouraged to e-mail their comments prior to the beginning of the meeting.
  KELSEY RIVADENEYRA

  CLERICAL ASSISTANT II

Dated: October 12, 2021

  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain to

minutes_text:
Unofficial until adopted by the  November 17, 2021
City Arts and Cultural Events Commission  Action Item III
  APPROVE

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  Wednesday, October 20, 2021
  7:00 P.M.

The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission was called to order at 7:01
P.M. on Wednesday, October 20, 2021, at Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street Alhambra,
via Video Conference Zoom.

ROLL CALL
Committee Members Present: President Canseco-Chan, Commission Member Jimenez, and
Commission Member Arambula
Committee Members Absent: Vice President Sanchez.
Also attending: Director Michael Macias, Deputy Director Brie Houghton, and Clerical Assistant
II Kelsey Rivadeneyra.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES FROM THE SEPTEMBER 15, 2021 C.A.C.E. MEETING
Due to lack of quorum, the September 15, 2021 City Arts and Cultural Events Commission
meeting minutes will be reviewed for approval at the next City Arts and Cultural Events
Commission meeting.

ALHAMBRA ART ALLEY PROJECT
Deputy Director Houghton shared results from the Alhambra Art Alley Community survey
showing 107 responses to date. It was also discussed how to proceed with the Public Art Request
for Proposal template with the commission. Commission Member Arambula recommended a
defined outline for funding in the Public Art Request for Proposal template. For reference and
consideration, the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission members will receive copies of the
Alhambra Art Alley Community survey responses and Public Art Request for Proposal template
via e-mail.

STAFF REPORT
Deputy Director Houghton thanked the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission members for
their attendance and a successful art installation. Appreciation was also expressed to the
commissioners for their help judging the pumpkin decorating contest at the October 2, 2021
Autumn Fest. Deputy Director Houghton invited the commission to participate as judges in the
upcoming December Holiday Home Decorating contest.

PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
None

COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
 None.

ADJOURNMENT
President Canseco-Chan moved to adjourn the October 20, 2021, City Arts and Cultural Events
Commission Meeting. Seconded by Commission Member Arambula, the meeting was adjourned
at 7:32 P.M.
